exposure: timing of spousal deployment relative to pregnancy and delivery (before, during, or after delivery)
cohort: The study participants were pregnant wives of active-duty U.S. service members, accounting for 161,454 births between 2004 and 2009.
finding: A modest significant association with postpartum depression was detected only in those whose husbands deployed during pregnancy and returned after delivery (OR 1.10, 95 % CI 1.04-1.15).
